description: Start a worker on one verifiable piece of work in its own git worktree and branch. It never commits or pushes. task is the whole brief: background, spec, write set, verify command, output format. followup_of continues a finished worker from its branch with its settings. runner: codex (default) or claude.

acceptance.description: {commands, timeout_ms}: shell commands the supervisor runs in the worktree after the worker exits; all must exit 0

context.description: {files: [{path}] abs paths to read, contracts: [binding statements]}

owned_paths.description: Paths it may change; overlap with an active worker is refused. Required unless followup_of

sandbox.description: {mode: read-only | workspace-write (default) | danger-full-access, network_access, writable_roots: [abs dirs], allowed_commands: [commands; trailing * = prefix], forbid: [paths or commands]}

session.description: {id, title, note}: one id per batch

workspace.description: {kind: git_worktree (default) | read_only_in_place | scratch | in_place_write, base_ref, setup: {links: [{path, source}], submodules, commands} run first, in_place_authorization, external_outputs: [{path}]}

name: create_worker
title: Dispatch a worker
